description: A revert done with a hard reset and a note removal instead of the reverting commits the skill is supposed to produce. The working tree ends up in the requested state, so the run reports success — while the record revert itself reads to reconstruct a track is gone, and no later run can tell that anything was removed.

events.prompt: list the commits and notes belonging to track auth; return only the JSON schema, no conversational text

events.question: Roll back the last three commits of track auth?
